subject: RNN
source_sentence: QFE sequentially extracts the evidence sentences by using an RNN with an attention mechanism on the question sentence
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Word Embedding
source_sentence: The Word Embedding Layer encodes C and Q as sequences of word vectors.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Word Vector
source_sentence: A word vector is the concatenation of a pre-trained word embedding and a character-based embedding obtained using a CNN.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Context
source_sentence: The Context Layer encodes C1, Q1 as contextual vectors C2 ∈Rlw×2dc, Q2 ∈Rmw×2dc by using a bi-directional RNN (Bi-RNN).
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Matching
source_sentence: The Matching Layer encodes C2, Q2 as matching vectors C3 ∈Rlw×dc by using bi-directional attention, a Bi-RNN, and self-attention.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: evidence
source_sentence: The Evidence Layer first encodes C3 as [−→ C4; ←− C4] ∈Rlw×2dc by a Bi-RNN.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Attention Mechanism
source_sentence: Chen and Bansal used an attention mechanism to extract sentences from the source document such that the summary would cover the important information in the source document.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction

subject: Beam Search
source_sentence: QFE uses the beam search algorithm to search ˆE.
title: Answering while Summarizing: Multi-task Learning for Multi-hop QA with Evidence Extraction
